data.content: The element is phosphorus (`p`), and nitrogen is `n`. I need to find bonds between phosphorus and nitrogen atoms. Let me query the connected table joining with atom to find P-N bonds

args.code_query:
SELECT c.atom_id, a1.element AS e1, c.atom_id2, a2.element AS e2, c.bond_id, b.bond_type, b.molecule_id
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE (a1.element = 'p' AND a2.element = 'n') OR (a1.element = 'n' AND a2.element = 'p');

data.content: The `connected` table stores each bond twice (both directions). Let me get the distinct bonds and their molecule labels.

args.code_query:
SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_id, b.bond_type, b.molecule_id, m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id IN ('TR032_2_3','TR032_3_5','TR058_1_3','TR058_1_4','TR058_1_5','TR298_1_5');

SELECT c.atom_id, a1.element AS e1, c.atom_id2, a2.element AS e2, c.bond_id, b.bond_type, b.molecule_id
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE (a1.element = 'p' AND a2.element = 'n') OR (a1.element = 'n' AND a2.element = 'p');

SELECT c.atom_id, a1.element AS e1, c.atom_id2, a2.element AS e2, c.bond_id, b.bond_type, b.molecule_id
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE (a1.element = 'p' AND a2.element = 'n') OR (a1.element = 'n' AND a2.element = 'p');

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_id, b.bond_type, b.molecule_id, m.label

WHERE b.bond_id IN ('TR032_2_3','TR032_3_5','TR058_1_3','TR058_1_4','TR058_1_5','TR298_1_5');
